in_marathi.name: Dashrathansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dashrathansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dashratha is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'ten chariots'. This name is associated with the legendary king Dashratha, who ruled Ayodhya and had Rama, Lakshmana, and Bharata as his sons.
